governing_observation: Left-click selection works live, proving 3D geometry -> pick id -> equipmentInstanceId -> selectedEquipmentId. That chain was not modified.
root_cause: Right-click was only handled via Bentley onResetButtonUp, which did not fire reliably live. The first EVI-MA-02B bridge attempt used IModelApp.locateManager.doLocate with a synthetic viewToWorld({z:0}) point, which is unreliable for a non-button contextmenu event, so equipment did not resolve. Left-click uses onDataButtonDown which fires — hence the asymmetry.

fix_right_click.approach: persistent viewport-level DOM contextmenu bridge with a PURE ray pick (no doLocate, no Bentley reset dependency)
methods: locateEquipmentAtClient (client px -> npc -> world near/far ray -> pickNearestEquipment)
pure_pick: pickNearestEquipment (nearest-along-ray, hidden excluded, reuses collision envelope math)
fix_right_click.on_bim_or_empty: no equipment menu; browser menu NOT suppressed
fix_right_click.menu_title: canonical manufacturer + model (e.g. IBA Cyclone KIUBE / IBA Cyclone KEY)

why_first_attempt_failed: First bridge resolved hits via doLocate with a synthetic near-plane world point; unreliable for contextmenu events. This revision uses a deterministic ray-vs-oriented-box pick against equipment envelopes, independent of Bentley locate/reset delivery.

fix_delete_key.wiring: BentleyViewer window keydown effect (AUTHENTICATED only) -> deleteEquipment(getSelectedEquipmentId())
fix_delete_key.locked_policy: not deleted; alert 'Unlock equipment before deleting.'

manual_acceptance_steps: Press Delete -> KEY disappears, KIUBE remains
Right-click KIUBE -> context menu appears at cursor
Right-click a BIM wall -> no equipment Delete menu
Place a cyclotron in the released area -> succeeds
stop_condition: Automated verification passes; dev server on 3000. STOP. Await manual EVI-MA-02B acceptance. Do not start PTS/RTHS/MRT animation/Build 2.
